scope: Separate local copy: multi-document hardware reasoning, excerpt citations, deterministic charging checks, proposal repair and actual canvas image review. No physical hardware validation, deployment or model superiority claim.

integrations.purpose: Reason over the assembly and full included design documents, revise proposals using deterministic check feedback, and visually inspect the actual rendered canvas.

checks.expected: Domain tests: exact citation matching, unsupported charge values, preservation and frozen requirements.
checks.observed: 194 tests passed; one older opt-in provider test skipped. New tests cover citations, source limits, review-gated numbers, frozen charging requirements and raw-image evidence.
Next.js production build and TypeScript completed successfully. Final production server is on loopback port 3001.

checks.expected: Browser conversion uses real Argon and passes listed geometry plus source checks.
checks.observed: Live gemini-4-argon conversion used eight files. Final proposal passed 17 listed checks; two engineering/source limits remained explicitly unverified. Apply changed 75 to 76 parts.

checks.expected: Conflicting charging requirement is blocked without silently relaxing it; normal-rate recovery passes.
checks.observed: 500 mA minimum with battery height <=4 mm was blocked after three attempts. Apply stayed disabled. Explicit return to 100 mA preserved the 4 mm requirement and passed.

checks.expected: Actual canvas image is sent to Argon and yields explicitly limited visual observations.
checks.observed: Actual browser canvas JPEG plus documents produced three live Argon observations. Exported JPEG SHA-256 matches the server-received image fingerprint.

checks.expected: A real PDF imports with correct page text and source numeric extraction; excerpt citations open their source.
checks.observed: Real manufacturer PDF imported with five native pages. Answer cited page 2 and opened the exact charging-voltage excerpt. Live numeric extraction produced a reviewed 150 mA maximum. Eight sources survived reload and notebook export/restore.

checks.expected: Original app remains clean at its original revision; new secrets excluded from source archive.
checks.observed: Original remains clean at the preserved revision. New copy has no remote or deployment link. Packaged source excludes environment files, dependencies, build output, Git internals and actual configured credential bytes.

checks.expected: An image import preserves image bytes without fabricated text or numeric facts, and real Argon can interpret it as visual evidence in the source-aware conversation.
checks.observed: Raw image import retained the image, with zero invented text pages and zero numeric facts. Real gemini-4-argon interpreted the visible 3.7 V nominal value as visual evidence and explicitly rejected exact-text/numeric-check authority.
